integrity: The complete standalone verifier is embedded with this item and can independently enumerate quotient distances in a bounded finite range; all embedded bytes have recorded hashes. No external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Scope is three-one binary necklaces under minimum cyclic Hamming and centres constrained to that same layer. The finite small-centre multiplicities use an exact exhaustive program, while the all-length radius theorem and the n=14 two-centre classification have independent analytic proofs. There is a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent difference-set classification; independent audit has not been performed.
title: The exceptional fourteen-cycle in cyclic-Hamming centres of three-one necklaces
